title: options
description: Options side by side, numbered cards each a title over parts (a picture, a diagram or code of the option), Markdown text, its pros (+) and cons (−); the one to take is ringed under a badge. The cards on a line start their parts and their text at one height

pick.description: Marks the option to take, with this word as its badge, such as Recommended

parts.description: Parts under the title, above the text, such as an image or a diagram of the option
